mission.Corp_Pirates_Elimination1.briefi: The target's location is marked on your map. The shuttle pilot does what he can, but the pirates detected our approach early and took actions. You know, they always fascinated me. People go into battle not only for profit, but also for fun. I still feel like a corporate tool, and I guess they are close to the <color=#FFFEC1>true freedom</color>.
mission.Corp_Pirates_Elimination1.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Eliminate the commander of the pirate crew.
mission.Corp_Pirates_Elimination1.detail:
Details: %STATION_NAME% has been in the hands of the Unchained Belt for quite some time. Of course, corporates are gritting their teeth because such a rich asset is idle. However, deciding to take direct actions now means facing unimaginable losses.

Now %STATION_NAME% is a real base of operations for pirates. It looks like one of the captains is here, with a large bounty on their head. If we want to gain the trust of %BENEFICIARY_NAME%, then we should take care of this gentleman of luck.
mission.Corp_Pirates_Elimination1.object: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Eliminate the commander of the pirate crew.
mission.Corp_Pirates_Escort1.after: As a reward for retaining a valuable employee, %BENEFICIARY_NAME% sent us a package. Let's hope the manager whose life we ​​saved today will be generous. The cargo is already on board Magnum.
mission.Corp_Pirates_Escort1.briefing: The target signature provided to us by %BENEFICIARY_NAME% is clearly visible. The location is marked on your map. <color=#FFFEC1>Escort</color> the valuable staff to the specified location at %STATION_NAME%. Move from level to level until you are safe. The attackers are <color=#FFFEC1>rabble</color> from all the outskirts of the System. Exploring %STATION_NAME% is not included in the task list, but act according to the circumstances.
mission.Corp_Pirates_Escort1.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Escort the manager of %BENEFICIARY_NAME% to the safe location.
mission.Corp_Pirates_Escort1.details:
Details: An ambitious project manager for %BENEFICIARY_NAME% works at %STATION_NAME%. He is taking effective measures against the public enemies in this part of the Solar System. Of course, this does not suit %VICTIM_NAME% at all.

The Security Service of %BENEFICIARY_NAME% has received information that these public enemies ordered the murder of the manager. We can take the contract for their protection. Not the most rewarding job, but it's a good way to improve your relationship with %BENEFICIARY_NAME%.
mission.Corp_Pirates_Escort1.objective0: Escort is a routine job. Your task: escort the manager to the <color=#FFFEC1>safe location</color> specified by the Security Service of %BENEFICIARY_NAME%.
mission.Corp_Pirates_Espionage1.after: %BENEFICIARY_NAME% is already studying the <color=#FFFEC1>PCPU</color> we obtained. It might want to take over %STATION_NAME%. Or maybe it will sell the data to the highest bidder. We'll watch. The reward has already been delivered to Magnum.
mission.Corp_Pirates_Espionage1.briefing: The pirates have turned %STATION_NAME% into a real garbage dump, but they protect it well. It won't be possible to land you near the target. Sensors show that the pirates are taking up defensive positions. The espionage operation to steal the <color=#FFFEC1>PCPU</color>, not yet begun, turned into a war. The good news: we've spotted the right device. It is marked on your map. Good luck.
mission.Corp_Pirates_Espionage1.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Pick up the pirate crew's <color=#FFFEC1>PCPU</color> at %STATION_NAME% and evacuate with it.
mission.Corp_Pirates_Espionage1.details:
Details: %STATION_NAME% is held by pirates. The assets of %BENEFICIARY_NAME% were attacked several times by these public enemies. Now %BENEFICIARY_NAME% really wants to know about their movements.

If %STATION_NAME% serves as a base of operations for the pirates, then the necessary data will definitely be there. You will need to pick up the portable computer personal unit (the PCPU) from the pirate crew, and then return with it to Magnum.
mission.Corp_Pirates_Espionage1.objectiv: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Pick up the pirate crew's <color=#FFFEC1>PCPU</color> at %STATION_NAME% and evacuate with it.
mission.Corp_Pirates_Infiltration1.after: Representatives of %BENEFICIARY_NAME% thank us for protecting the prototype. Gratitude is more like an advertising brochure about how a new product will help all of humanity. The point, of course, is not this, but the rate of profit. Therefore, our reward should not be small.
mission.Corp_Pirates_Infiltration1.brief:
Our opponents are rabble from the outskirts of the Solar System. The HIS of %VICTIM_NAME% is hovering nearby, it is irradiating %STATION_NAME% with a geoscanner. Rough work, but it has probably detected a new signature from the experimental prototype.

We need to land on the station and eliminate all infiltration teams. Be distracted by profiting from your employers' things only if it doesn't interfere with your main job.
mission.Corp_Pirates_Infiltration1.detai:
Details: Analysts were able to calculate an interesting pattern in the information flow regarding the activities of %BENEFICIARY_NAME%. Agents of %VICTIM_NAME% found out that some prototype was being developed at %STATION_NAME%. Most likely they will try to take it over because they want to close the technological gap with the corporations.

If we want to improve the attitude of %BENEFICIARY_NAME% towards us, we need to protect the prototype.
mission.Corp_Pirates_RaiderCapture1.afte: %BENEFICIARY_NAME% is conducting an information campaign about its success in combating piracy. Its competitors are focusing on the fact that %STATION_NAME% is now in the hands of %BENEFICIARY_NAME%. We are waiting for new contracts, <color=#FFFEC1>Boss</color>. By the way, the reward is already on board Magnum.
mission.Corp_Pirates_RaiderCapture1.brie: %STATION_NAME% is at your complete disposal. <color=#FFFEC1>Kill all the pirates</color>! According to <color=#FFFEC1>NCE</color>, they are public enemies. Once their losses become too great, they will leave this place. Pirates won't hold on to this piece of metal. Keep your eyes open so you don't find yourself without the necessary supplies at a critical moment.
mission.Corp_Pirates_RaiderCapture1.deta:
Details: The time has come to shine in the propaganda of the anarcho-capitalist regime. Indirectly, of course. %BENEFICIARY_NAME% actively posts messages in the SBN about the inadmissibility of %STATION_NAME% remaining in the hands of public enemies. This is a signal for us and other PMCs.

The task is simple: we go in and kill as many pirates as possible. They must retreat, sooner or later.

When the job is done, we will leave %STATION_NAME%. And let the corporations deal with the new asset.
mission.Corp_Pirates_Sabotage1.after: %BENEFICIARY_NAME% is already spreading information about its unprecedented success in the fight against piracy. %STATION_NAME% is now ready to be liberated by corporates. Well, if anyone wants to do this, we're always here. The employer sent us the due cargo.
mission.Corp_Pirates_Sabotage1.briefing: Your targets have been marked on the map. You may explore %STATION_NAME% if you believe there is something of interest there, but avoid unnecessary risks. %BENEFICIARY_NAME% will accept nothing less than a successful outcome of the mission.
mission.Corp_Pirates_Sabotage1.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Destroy the pirate crew's supply warehouse.
mission.Corp_Pirates_Sabotage1.details:
Details: %STATION_NAME% has been in the hands of the Unchained Belt for quite some time. Gradually, this place became the main base of operations for pirates on and around the planet. Public enemies are completely excluded from market relations in the System. They have to replenish supplies in other ways.

Recently, one of the spacecrafts of %BENEFICIARY_NAME% was boarded. The entire cargo was stolen. Corporation analysts traced the attackers' path to %STATION_NAME%. We now have a contract for destruction of the stolen supplies.
mission.Corp_Pirates_Sabotage1.objective: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Destroy the pirate crew's supply warehouse.
mission.Corp_Pirates_Security1.after: %BENEFICIARY_NAME% will have to deal with the mess that the public enemies caused at %STATION_NAME% for a long time. The reward is already on Magnum.
mission.Corp_Pirates_Security1.briefing: The %VICTIM_NAME% group has dispatched special squads to %STATION_NAME% to locate and seize critical equipment and data. You must <color=#FFFEC1>prevent these squads from leaving the station</color>. The corporation %BENEFICIARY_NAME% will consider it a failure if even one such squad escapes.
mission.Corp_Pirates_Security1.details: <color=#FFFEC1>Boss</color>, %VICTIM_NAME% is attacking %STATION_NAME%, regardless of losses. %BENEFICIARY_NAME% is requesting assistance. If we respond, we will need to <color=#FFFEC1>provide the attackers with a decent greeting</color> until corporate reinforcements arrive.
mission.Corp_Pirates_Security1.objective: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Prevent the pirate squads from escaping %STATION_NAME%. I will mark them on your map.
mission.Corp_Shedu_Control1.after: The meeting with representatives of %BENEFICIARY_NAME% took place. The reward was transferred to Magnum. We were the only ones who responded when it became clear that the attackers were <color=#FFFEC1>quasimorphs</color>.
mission.Corp_Shedu_Control1.briefing: <color=#FFFEC1>Quasimorphs</color> of %VICTIM_NAME% are already attacking %STATION_NAME%. Methodically kill them, <color=#FFFEC1>don’t let them break</color> the communication equipment.
mission.Corp_Shedu_Control1.details: <color=#FFFEC1>Details:</color> %VICTIM_NAME% is preparing an attack in this part of the Solar System. %BENEFICIARY_NAME% is trying in any way to retain %STATION_NAME%. The quasimorphs seem to be targeting the <color=#FFFEC1>communications equipment</color> of the station. %BENEFICIARY_NAME% will be extremely grateful to us if we stop them.
mission.Corp_Shedu_Control1.objective0: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Protect the communications equipment of %BENEFICIARY_NAME%. It is a satellite dish aimed into space.
mission.Corp_Shedu_Counterattack1.after: %BENEFICIARY_NAME% has already transferred the reward to Magnum. I can’t shake the feeling that it was watching what was happening at the station and collecting information. Do you feel like a laboratory mouse, <color=#FFFEC1>Boss</color>?
mission.Corp_Shedu_Counterattack1.briefi: It will not be possible to drop you off close to the ritual site. A real war has been going on at %STATION_NAME% for several days. We'll have to hurry. Quasimorphs must be stopped!
mission.Corp_Shedu_Counterattack1.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Eliminate the group of quasimorphs from %VICTIM_NAME% before the <color=#FFFEC1>ritual</color> is completed.
mission.Corp_Shedu_Counterattack1.detail: <color=#FFFEC1>Details:</color> Recently, jumps in quasimorphosis have been recorded at %STATION_NAME%. This is not stated directly, but our analysts have long learned to recognize the corresponding hints in the <color=#FFFEC1>SBN</color>. Apparently, this activity attracted %VICTIM_NAME% here. They have captured part of the station and are preparing to hold some kind of <color=#FFFEC1>ritual</color> there. We must not let them finish what they started. %BENEFICIARY_NAME% promises a worthy reward.
mission.Corp_Shedu_Counterattack1.object: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Eliminate the group of quasimorphs from %VICTIM_NAME% before the <color=#FFFEC1>ritual</color> is completed.
mission.Corp_Shedu_Defense1.after: The reward from %BENEFICIARY_NAME% is already on Magnum. If we can hold off even %VICTIM_NAME%, does that mean we can destroy them? Or is it just the euphoria of successfully completing a mission?
mission.Corp_Shedu_Defense1.briefing: As soon as we get you there, the attack will begin. Sensors show that quasimorphs have already appeared in certain places of %STATION_NAME%. <color=#FFFEC1>Hold out as long as possible</color>, their onslaught will certainly weaken.
mission.Corp_Shedu_Defense1.details:
Details: Due to an information quarantine blocking any reports of quasimorphosis, %BENEFICIARY_NAME% is unable to directly report that %STATION_NAME% is about to be attacked by %VICTIM_NAME%.

Quasimorphs not only know how to linger in physical reality, but also have learned to bypass the SBN filters. They constantly transmit messages to the network. The Hexarchy immediately declares them fakes of the Civil Resistance.

If we want a reward from %BENEFICIARY_NAME%, then we should hurry.
mission.Corp_Shedu_Elimination1.after: %BENEFICIARY_NAME% asked us to provide us with a report on the events that accompanied the completion of tasks. A lot of effort went into preparing it. Perhaps it was more difficult than killing that quasimorph? Let's hope the reward in Magnum's cargo bay was worth the pain.
mission.Corp_Shedu_Elimination1.briefing: The sensors are almost completely blind: we observe unimaginable leaps of quasimorphosis. We'll drop you off wherever we can. <color=#FFFEC1>Kill the Duke</color>. Don't try to be a hero and clear out the entire %STATION_NAME%, it's not in the contract.
mission.Corp_Shedu_Elimination1.details:
Details: %BENEFICIARY_NAME% has launched activities around %STATION_NAME%. It wants to get this asset, but, judging by the analysis of data from the SBN, not yet ready for direct actions. The corporatists can be understood: %STATION_NAME% is in the clutches of %VICTIM_NAME%, which has openly challenged the human world order. These quasimorphs have somehow learned to linger in our reality for a long time. We can test the strength of their defenses.

It is known from %BENEFICIARY_NAME% that a quasimorph of the duke type was spotted at %STATION_NAME%. If we manage to kill it, then the forces of %VICTIM_NAME% here will be significantly weakened. Of course, we are not doing this to save humanity. %BENEFICIARY_NAME% indicated that PMC, which takes on this work, will receive a good reward.
mission.Corp_Shedu_Escort1.after: As a reward for saving a valuable employee, %BENEFICIARY_NAME% sent us a package so that we could conduct field tests. There are some of its new products. The cargo is already on board Magnum.
mission.Corp_Shedu_Escort1.briefing: The target signature provided to us by %BENEFICIARY_NAME% is clearly visible. <color=#FFFEC1>Escort</color> the security officer to the specified location at %STATION_NAME%. The attackers are <color=#FFFEC1>quasimorphs</color>, so be extremely careful. Exploring %STATION_NAME% is not included in the task list, but if you see something important, act according to the circumstances.
mission.Corp_Shedu_Escort1.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Escort the security officer of %BENEFICIARY_NAME% to the safe location.
mission.Corp_Shedu_Escort1.details: <color=#FFFEC1>Details:</color> The headquarters of the security officer of %BENEFICIARY_NAME% is located at %STATION_NAME%. Recently, they have carried out several successful operations against quasimorphs. And now %VICTIM_NAME% is about to attack the station. If we take on this fixed-term contract, we will need to bring the <color=#FFFEC1>security officer to the safe location</color>.
mission.Corp_Shedu_Escort1.objective0: New day, new quasimorphs. <color=#FFFEC1>Your task</color>: escort the Security Service officer to the safe location. Perhaps it is this person who will later lead the resistance when %VICTIM_NAME% becomes a problem.
mission.Corp_Shedu_Espionage1.after: The meeting with a representative of %BENEFICIARY_NAME% took place. It's a good deal: worthless rock in exchange for valuable cargo.
mission.Corp_Shedu_Espionage1.briefing:
The signature of the igvalite has been found, its location is marked on your map. Move through %STATION_NAME% carefully, save your strength. %BENEFICIARY_NAME% is ready to reward well for this rock.

We will try to drop you off as close to the place as possible, but we cannot promise anything: the shuttle pilot reports strange visions.
mission.Corp_Shedu_Espionage1.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Pick up the <color=#FFFEC1>igvalite</color> at %STATION_NAME% and evacuate with it.
mission.Corp_Shedu_Espionage1.details:
Details: Despite the suppression of information by the Hexarchy, it is known that %STATION_NAME% is in the hands of quasimorphs from %VICTIM_NAME%. %BENEFICIARY_NAME% discovered something interesting there.

A reconnaissance drone sent there picked up the signature of an igvalite, a quasimorphic artifact capable of accumulating gavvakh. It appears that %VICTIM_NAME% is using this station for energy storage. We have work to do.

%BENEFICIARY_NAME% offers a job to infiltrate %STATION_NAME% and pick up the igvalite.
mission.Corp_Shedu_Espionage1.objective0: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Find the <color=#FFFEC1>igvalite</color> - a quasimorphic artifact similar to a mineral, and then return with it to Magnum. Stealing is included in the standard range of our services. The fact that we are operating in the territory of quasimorphs does not change anything.
mission.Corp_Shedu_RaiderCapture1.after: As expected, %BENEFICIARY_NAME% claimed %STATION_NAME% as its property. What happened there is a corporate secret. We got what we were due: the cargo from %BENEFICIARY_NAME% is already on Magnum.
mission.Corp_Shedu_RaiderCapture1.briefi:
We don't know why exactly these quasimorphs remain in our reality. As a rule, the quasimorphosis subsides soon after the violence stops. But %VICTIM_NAME% has learned to overcome this limitation. You'll have to work manually.

After disembarking, methodically move forward through %STATION_NAME% and shoot everything that moves. Keep your eyes open and try to be prepared for any turn of events. Good luck.
mission.Corp_Shedu_RaiderCapture1.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Eliminate <color=#FFFEC1>50% of the quasimorphs</color> living on %STATION_NAME%.
mission.Corp_Shedu_RaiderCapture1.detail:
Details: Quasimorphosis is gradually ceasing to be a mystery. The Hexarchy is trying to maintain the appearance of control: everything unusual is presented as provocations of the Civil Resistance. %BENEFICIARY_NAME% sent a notification via the SBN that it was going to conduct an orphan asset inspection. In other words, it is ready to attract PMC to take %STATION_NAME% away from the quasimorphs. After our victory, it will declare what happened as its contribution to the restoration of order in the System. Let it say what it wants, the main thing is that it will have to invest heavily in us.

Here's what you need to do: walk around %STATION_NAME% and kill as many quasimorphs as possible. Somehow, %VICTIM_NAME% was able to train quasimorphs to linger in physical reality for a long time.

When we leave this place, the smart guys of %BENEFICIARY_NAME% will arrive and put %STATION_NAME% in order.
mission.Corp_Shedu_RaiderCapture1.object: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Eliminate <color=#FFFEC1>50% of the quasimorphs</color> living on %STATION_NAME%.
mission.Corp_Shedu_Sabotage1.after: %BENEFICIARY_NAME% is extremely grateful for your assistance in... studying %STATION_NAME%. The cargo is already on board Magnum.
mission.Corp_Shedu_Sabotage1.briefing: These <color=#FFFEC1>reliquaries</color>... they light up our sensors. Finding and destroying them is a very good idea. Be extremely careful: %STATION_NAME% is literally crawling with quasimorphs. Stay focused on the objective and do not allow yourself to be distracted. At any moment, the situation can only deteriorate.
mission.Corp_Shedu_Sabotage1.details:
Details: The Hexarchy, via SBN, reports that the proceedings concerning the unusual events in the Solar System are still ongoing. However, corporations are unwilling to wait for official authorization, and an increasing number of assets in the Inner System are becoming “orphaned.” No one officially acknowledges the existence of quasimorphs. Assets currently controlled by the quasimorphic faction %VICTIM_NAME% can therefore be appropriated. As a result, %BENEFICIARY_NAME% has a strong interest in %STATION_NAME%, but is not prepared for direct action.

According to their information, this location contains one or more objects resembling statues or obelisks. These artifacts are unquestionably of quasimorphic origin. %BENEFICIARY_NAME% refers to them as reliquaries and is willing to pay handsomely for their destruction.

We believe that these reliquaries are connected to the ability of quasimorphs to maintain a prolonged presence in physical reality.
mission.Corp_Shedu_Sabotage1.objective0: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Find and destroy the <color=#FFFEC1>reliquaries</color> — quasimorphic artifacts resembling obelisks.
mission.Corp_Tezctlan_Control1.after: The meeting with representatives of %BENEFICIARY_NAME% took place. The reward was transferred to Magnum. We were the only ones who responded when it became clear that the attackers were <color=#FFFEC1>quasimorphs</color>.
mission.Corp_Tezctlan_Control1.briefing: <color=#FFFEC1>Quasimorphs</color> of %VICTIM_NAME% are already attacking %STATION_NAME%. Methodically kill them, <color=#FFFEC1>don’t let them break</color> the communication equipment.
mission.Corp_Tezctlan_Control1.details: <color=#FFFEC1>Details:</color> %VICTIM_NAME% is preparing an attack in this part of the Solar System. %BENEFICIARY_NAME% is trying in any way to retain %STATION_NAME%. The quasimorphs seem to be targeting the <color=#FFFEC1>communications equipment</color> of the station. %BENEFICIARY_NAME% will be extremely grateful to us if we stop them.
mission.Corp_Tezctlan_Control1.objective: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Protect the communications equipment of %BENEFICIARY_NAME%. It is a satellite dish aimed into space.
mission.Corp_Tezctlan_Counterattack1.aft: %BENEFICIARY_NAME% has already transferred the reward to Magnum. I can’t shake the feeling that it was watching what was happening at the station and collecting information. Do you feel like a laboratory mouse, <color=#FFFEC1>Boss</color>?
mission.Corp_Tezctlan_Counterattack1.bri: It will not be possible to drop you off close to the ritual site. A real war has been going on at %STATION_NAME% for several days. We'll have to hurry. Quasimorphs must be stopped!
mission.Corp_Tezctlan_Counterattack1.des: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Eliminate the group of quasimorphs from %VICTIM_NAME% before the <color=#FFFEC1>ritual</color> is completed.
